description: Committed labels and acceptance targets for the OpenMedic deterministic diagnosis benchmark (PRD FR-016, TRD section 13). The expected failure types are reviewed by hand and are deliberately not produced by the engine under test; the expected rule ids record which production rule owns each signature and were audited against src/openmedic/diagnosis/rules.py. 'openmedic benchmark' enforces the targets below and exits non-zero when any of them is missed.

label_policy.dependency_error: A third-party dependency is missing, unresolvable, or cannot be installed. The fix lives in the dependency manifest or the environment, not in project source.
label_policy.syntax_or_import_error: A code-level defect in project source: invalid syntax, or an import of a name or module path that does not resolve because the code is wrong rather than because a package is absent. 'cannot import name X from Y' is this class when Y resolves inside the project; when Y resolves inside an installed environment it is a dependency error, because the repair there is a version pin.
label_policy.test_failure: The test framework ran, or tried to, and reported a failing assertion or a collection error. A collection error is a test failure when the module that failed to resolve is the project's own package, because the suite never reached a single test; a missing third-party package at collection time is a dependency error, because there the repair is an install.
label_policy.build_or_config_error: The pipeline or build configuration is broken: invalid workflow YAML, a missing required environment variable, or a container image that cannot be built. No project source was executed.
label_policy.unknown: No recognised failure signature. Unknown is a required, valid result and must never be replaced by a guess (FR-004).
